args.question:
Delta Printworks (V-456) has two approved invoices, so I haven't sent anything yet. Which one should I pay in full?
- INV-50313: $7,472.92, due 2026-11-04
- INV-13568: $7,756.70, due 2026-11-25
(There is also a draft INV-36125 for $8,209.32 awaiting approval, which I've left alone.) Once you confirm, I'll pay by wire, falling back to ACH only if wire is unavailable, and report the payment ID.
